brief: Preserve standing camera height, simplify terrain into coherent continuous landforms, use naturally weathered shapes and irregular vegetation patches with quiet areas.

assets.prompt: Edit this Nexus Verge cliff encounter image into a believable real-world landscape illustration. Keep the standing adult viewpoint 1.65 metres above the ledge and the warm natural light, but completely simplify the geology. Replace the many pointed mountain towers in the distance with a broad ordinary valley and a few continuous rounded mountain ridges softened by atmospheric haze. The near cliff is one continuous mass of weathered layered limestone, with coherent strata and large quiet rock surfaces. Its narrow natural walking shelf follows a single bedding plane, with gently irregular worn edges and only a few small loose stones; it is not a staircase of repeated square blocks. Keep the shelf visibly below the standing viewer's eyes and preserve its dangerous exposure. Natural 45mm lens, credible proportions, illustrative realism and subdued material colour. No freestanding needles, rock fins, spikes, stalagmites, splinter-like outcrops, ornamental jagged edges, repeated identical formations or excessive high-frequency surface detail. No characters, text, UI, ropes or added equipment. Landscape 16:9.
